messages:
Fiona (Finance): BillingBot flagged a $9,120 charge on 2026-07-12 in asia-east1 marked unallocated. Sophie says it may be from a partner POC + internal experiments sharing the same cluster. Need fast attribution before invoice sends.
BillingBot: ALERT: 2026-07-12 01:47 UTC - UNALLOCATED_GPU - $9,120 - 14 GPUs - projects: 6 - /billing/alerts/20260712-77
Mei (Platform): Querying usage export now. My hunch: shared-gpu-cluster had mixed workloads and our per-job label propagation faltered for containerized runs.
Raj (ML Eng): We ran two big experiments last night: transfer-sweep (team), and zenith-partner-POC (partner). I launched zenith jobs under partner project but reused the cluster.
Sophie (CS): Partner (Zenith) is sensitive—they expect strict separation. If they were billed for internal noise we'll need to credit and run root-cause.
Mei (Platform): Running SQL:
```
SELECT project_id, job_tag, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM billing.gpu_line_items
WHERE date='2026-07-12' AND region='asia-east1' AND label_account IS NULL
GROUP BY project_id, job_tag ORDER BY cost DESC;
```
Mei (Platform): Top results: shared-gpu-cluster (unassigned) $6,350; zenith-partner-project (partial) $1,900; infra-maintenance $870.
Fiona (Finance): So ~$6.35k unassigned on the cluster. If partner portion confirmed, we need to retro-assign and issue credit memo if they were charged. Can platform backfill?
Mei (Platform): Yes. I can run targeted backfill matching container image + job ids. ETA 40m. Backfill script:
```
/tools/cost-backfill --cluster shared-gpu-cluster --date 2026-07-12 --match-labels job_id,image --assign label_account=zenith
```
Raj (ML Eng): I'll supply the zenith job ids (7002-7020) in FIN-1503. Note: some runs spawned ephemeral sidecars that may not have inherited labels.
VendorOps: NOTICE: Zenith has a negotiated passthrough price for partner workloads; confirm attribution before applying discount: partner-discount=12%. Contact partnerships@zenith.ai
Omar (VP Finance): Provisional approval: credit up to $2,500 if partner was incorrectly billed. For the remainder, recommend we run an internal cost-split experiment: 50/50 on ambiguous cluster time for 30 days, then review. Need Finance sign-off.
Fiona (Finance): I don't want to set a sticky precedent. Propose: 1) backfill & attribute confirmed partner usage; 2) anything truly unassignable goes to infra buffer for Q3; 3) run a pricing experiment for shared cluster accounting but don't apply retro-splits without explicit sign-off.
Sophie (CS): I'll pause the invoice until FIN-1503 confirms numbers. Partner prefers clear comms if we issue a credit.
Mei (Platform): Backfill started. Progress: 35% complete. Will post CSV diff to FIN-1503 when done.
BillingBot: Created FIN-1503 and attached initial alert export /billing/exports/20260712-unalloc.csv
Raj (ML Eng): Action: I'll add job manifests to FIN-1503 and flag which runs are partner.
Mei (Platform): Backfill complete. Diff: assigned $1,900 to zenith-partner-project, $870 to infra-maintenance, remaining $6,350 -> after matching containers 70% remains unassigned (~$4,320). Uploaded /billing/exports/20260712-backfill-diff.csv to FIN-1503.
Fiona (Finance): OK. Draft plan: 1) issue partner credit for $1,900 if they were billed (apply 12% discount if contract requires), 2) absorb $4,320 into infra buffer, 3) open pricing experiment RFC for shared-cluster attribution rules. I'll create FIN-1503 tasks.
Omar (VP Finance): Approve that plan. Also require a weekly orphan-report for next 6 weeks and scoreboard for the experiment.
Sophie (CS): I'll prepare partner-facing note with tentative credit amount and request confirmation.
Mei (Platform): Action items: add validation in container label propagation, schedule nightly orphan-sweep, and add an automated invoice-delta exporter to FIN-1503.
Fiona (Finance): Thanks everyone. Recap: FIN-1503 will track backfill CSV, partner credit draft, infra buffer allocation, and pricing-experiment RFC. I'll follow up with the draft memo before sending to Zenith.
